kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Greetings from a wildlife park in central Sri Lanka that's a haven for elephants
wire.summary: At a time of increased conflict between elephants and humans, as elephant habitats are converted to intensive agriculture, the Hurulu Eco Park is a place where the animals can graze unimpeded.

wire.title: Trump administration moves to deregulate Head Start, opening door for sweeping change
wire.summary: It would slim regulation of the 60-year-old anti-poverty program and aim to save money. Advocates worry the changes could undermine the early education program's mission.

wire.title: How Cambodia became the first Asian country to hit an elusive HIV target
wire.summary: The United Nations has set a goal for near universal HIV diagnosis and treatment for all by 2030. No country in Asia has hit the mark — until this year.

wire.title: El-Sayed wins Michigan's primary. And, Fauci faces contempt of Congress vote
wire.summary: Abdul El-Sayed has won Michigan's Democratic Senate primary and will face Republican Congressman Mike Rogers in the midterms. And, today, Dr. Anthony Fauci faces a contempt of Congress vote.

wire.title: Hospital staff said he was faking it and released him. He died from an overdose soon after
wire.summary: Addiction treatments are safe, effective — and rarely offered to patients. That's because many doctors and nurses still view people with alcohol or drug addiction with suspicion and hostility.

wire.title: Celebrity culture is one thing. For TMZ, Congress is the new 'reality show'
wire.summary: TMZ is trading Hollywood gossip for Capitol Hill scoops with a new D.C. bureau, launched in April. The online tabloid's two-man crew has brought an unconventional reporting style to the Congress beat.

wire.title: Gianni Infantino gets internal support at crisis meeting to remain as FIFA president
wire.summary: FIFA said Wednesday it had apologized for errors made over Gianni Infantino's failed plan to sell stakes in the World Cup and that senior staff in attendance at a crisis meeting in Morocco "reaffirmed their full support" for his presidency.

wire.title: Morning news brief
wire.summary: Iran says it's close to a deal with Oman over navigation on the Strait of Hormuz, a look at the challenges both candidates for Michigan's U.S. Senate seat will face, Trump touts U.S. economy in Vegas.

wire.title: Senate Homeland Security committee votes to hold Fauci in contempt of Congress
wire.summary: Republicans on the Senate Homeland Security Committee voted to hold Fauci in contempt of Congress after he refused to answer their questions about the government's response to the COVID-19 pandemic.

wire.title: Drone with explosives found at German airport, official sees 'new quality' of threat
wire.summary: Regional police and prosecutors said an airport employee discovered a drone near the airport's south runway with "an unknown explosive device," and the object was examined by police

wire.title: Ukraine hits two oil refineries deep in Russian territory
wire.summary: Ukraine's president says the strikes aim to limit revenues Russia "used to finance" its war.

wire.title: US Senate committee votes to hold Fauci in contempt over Covid hearing
wire.summary: The committee will now refer him for potential prosecution following his refusal to answer questions during a hearing focused on his handling of the Covid-19 pandemic.

wire.title: Iran says deal with Oman on Strait of Hormuz is in final stages
wire.summary: Neither the US or Oman have commented on the proposed agreement on the vital waterway.

wire.title: DR Congo river boat under quarantine for Ebola after five deaths
wire.summary: The health minister says all the passengers are being screened as a precautionary measure.

wire.title: EasyJet agrees to £5.7bn takeover by US firm
wire.summary: The no-frills carrier agrees to be bought by US firm Apollo after a rival suitor drops out.

wire.title: Livestreamer's murder raises questions over relations between Mexico's creators and cartels
wire.summary: The murder of content creator César Gastélum on Tuesday raises questions about why influencers are coming under attack.
